lines: 逆仙成魔传最新章节_第十章 铸魔洞窟第1页_逆仙成魔传废个球_热点小说网
> 第十章 铸魔洞窟（第1页）
“那怎么办啊”听到石头说的话李磊也是一惊，因为他根本没想到这个机遇要是利用不好却是天大的灾祸。
此时在李磊体内的仿佛是一颗极度危险的定时炸弹，只要稍有不慎就会爆体而亡。
“这个本女王不太清楚，但是目前来看情况还算稳定，只要到了天庭找到雷祖就应该能有化解之法，前提是你得努力爬!”
九重天上，凌霄宝殿内，玉皇大帝正和群仙商讨三重天雷劫对策。
“依老祖的意思，拥有三重天雷劫的人乃是天之骄子，万万不可大意，众爱卿可有对策”此时玉皇大帝站在大殿中间左右踱步着，看的出玉皇大帝十分着急。
而大殿之内众神仙更是乱成一锅粥，互相商讨着，想要制定一个非常妥当的方案。
因为听到玉皇大帝讲述大家十分清楚这三重天雷劫的厉害程度，如果任由其发展后果不堪设想。
“陛下，老臣有一方法不知当讲不当讲”开口的是一个仙风道骨的老头此人正是太白金星。
“既然三重天雷劫是飞升渡劫之人所触发的，虽然不知是谁触发，不如将今日渡劫飞升成仙全部集中重点培养”
可是太白金星刚说完话，其他神仙却都不淡定了，一个个面色惨白，那一双双眼睛全都看向了太白金星，又连忙看向玉帝。
“哈哈哈，好!好!不愧是我的爱卿”玉帝笑着说道。
其实以玉帝的能力难道想不出这个主意吗，万一有个差池他可不想被洪荒之书牵扯进去，现在正和他心意，这太白金星可以当挡箭牌来使了。
“陛下，万万不可啊!如果出了什么事情可会扰乱天机的啊”一个神仙跪下说道那语气极其卑微，仿佛要哭出来似的。
其他神仙见到这般模样也都纷纷跪下劝道。
眼下这个大殿除了太白金星和玉皇大帝是站着的，再没有一个神仙是站着的了。
因为他们知道想要让今天渡劫飞升成仙全部集中起来可是要开启那束升大阵的。
虽然开启大阵可以强行集中起来防止乱跑，但是不怕一万就怕万一啊，万一有个三长两短可是会严重扰乱天机的，扰乱天机的后果可能对玉帝没有影响，但是对他们影响可是非常严重的，轻则影响修炼，重则直接危害他们的性命。
“够了!朕已经决定了，太白金星快去准备，众爱卿退下吧”玉皇大帝怒声说道，可以看出玉皇大帝对这件事非常的用心，但他决定的事可不是其他人可以左右的。
“是，微臣告退”见太白金星走了，众神仙也纷纷告辞退下了。
在李磊那边，李磊甚是无聊因为飞升的人在飞升的路上是不可交流的，因为这是非常神圣的事情，于是李磊又和石头聊了起来，可以看出李磊和石头还是挺有共同语言的。
“对了还没有问你叫什么名字呢”李磊问道。
“哎呀，不用客气，你就叫我女王大人就行”
“呸，一个石头，还女王大人，我就叫你石头好了”李磊满脸鄙夷道。
“就不叫，就不叫，你能拿我怎么样，石头，石头，略略略!”
“你！哼”石头冷哼一声，便和李磊争论起来了。
可是李磊忽然将目光停留在一个诡异的洞窟上了，那洞窟不是很大才有一人高两人宽，正散发着非常汹涌的魔气，而且洞窟上刻着几个大字，铸魔洞窟!
令李磊感到奇怪的是明明是飞升成仙的道路好端端的怎么会凭空出现一个充满魔气的洞窟呢？

> Chapter 10 Demon Casting Cave (Page 1)
"Then what should we do?" Li Lei was also surprised when he heard what Shitou said, because he never thought that this opportunity would be a huge disaster if it was not used properly.
At this time, Li Lei's body seemed to be an extremely dangerous time bomb. If he was not careful, he would explode and die.
"I don't know much about this, but the situation seems to be quite stable at present. As long as you find Lei Zu in Heaven, you should be able to find a solution. The premise is that you have to work hard to climb!"
On the ninth level of heaven, in the Lingxiao Palace, the Jade Emperor was discussing with the immortals how to deal with the third level of thunder tribulation.
"According to the wishes of the ancestors, those who have the third level of thunder tribulation are the proud sons of heaven. They must not be careless. My dear friends, do you have any countermeasures?" At this time, the Jade Emperor stood in the middle of the hall and paced around. It could be seen that the Jade Emperor was very anxious.
And the gods in the main hall were in a mess, discussing with each other, trying to formulate a very appropriate plan.
Because after listening to the Jade Emperor's narration, everyone was very aware of the severity of this triple heavenly thunder tribulation, and if it was allowed to develop, the consequences would be disastrous.
"Your Majesty, I have a method that I don't know whether to explain or not." The person who spoke was an old man with a fairy-like manner. This person was none other than Taibai Jinxing.
"Since the third level of thunder tribulation is triggered by the person who ascended to transcend the tribulation, although I don't know who triggered it, it is better to focus on cultivating all the people who have transcended the tribulation and ascended to immortality today."
But as soon as Taibai Jinxing finished speaking, the other gods were no longer calm. They all looked pale, and all their eyes looked at Taibai Jinxing, and then quickly looked at the Jade Emperor.
"Hahaha, good! Good! As expected of my beloved," the Jade Emperor said with a smile.
In fact, with the Jade Emperor's ability, couldn't he come up with this idea? If something goes wrong, he doesn't want to be involved in the Book of Prehistoric Times. Now that it suits his heart, the Taibai Venus can be used as a shield.
"Your Majesty, you must not do this! If something happens, it will disturb the secret of heaven." A god knelt down and said in an extremely humble tone, as if he was about to cry.
When other gods saw this appearance, they all knelt down to persuade him.
At present, in this hall, except for Taibai Jinxing and the Jade Emperor, there is no other immortal standing.
Because they knew that if they wanted to gather all the people who would transcend the tribulation and ascend to immortality today, they would have to activate the Ascension Formation.
Although activating the large formation can force them to concentrate and prevent them from running around, you should not be afraid of ten thousand, but be afraid of the unexpected. If there are three long and two short, it will seriously disrupt the secret of heaven. The consequences of disrupting the secret of heaven may not have an impact on the Jade Emperor, but it will have a very serious impact on them. It will affect their cultivation at least, and directly endanger their lives at worst.
"That's enough! I have decided. Taibai Jinxing, hurry up and get ready. Dear friends, please step back," the Jade Emperor said angrily. It can be seen that the Jade Emperor is very serious about this matter, but what he decides cannot be controlled by others.
"Yes, I will take my leave." Seeing that Taibai Jinxing had left, all the gods also took their leave.
On Li Lei's side, Li Lei was very bored because people who ascended were not allowed to communicate with each other on the way to ascension, because it was a very sacred thing, so Li Lei chatted with Shitou again. It can be seen that Li Lei and Shitou still have a common language.
"By the way, I haven't asked you what your name is yet," Li Lei asked.
"Oh, you're welcome, just call me Queen."
"Bah, if you give me back a stone to Your Majesty the Queen, I will call you a stone," Li Lei said with disdain on his face.
"Don't scream, don't scream, what can you do to me, stone, stone, just a little bit!"
"You! Huh!" Shitou snorted coldly and started arguing with Li Lei.
But Li Lei suddenly focused his attention on a strange cave. The cave was not very big, only one person high and two people wide. It was exuding a very strong demonic energy, and there were several big characters carved on the cave: Demonic Cave!
What makes Li Lei feel strange is that the path to ascending to immortality is obviously smooth. How could a cave full of demonic energy appear out of thin air?
